PULSE CATHEDRAL / DEVELOPMENT BENCHMARK

What the camera signal actually contains

First 120 seconds of an official MPU-rPPG sample. All traces below are numeric signals; no face images are embedded. This is a diagnostic experiment, not held-out physiological validation.

Not ready for IBI/HRV accuracy claims. The sample lacks raw synchronization timestamps and independently reviewed beat labels. Its 60 fps container also shows a strong three-frame image-change cadence. Pairing is inferred from adjacent file IDs and identical frame/reference row counts.

MethodHR MAE vs device HRScored windows/readoutsAccepted readout fraction

Classical baselines use offline zero-phase filtering and overlapping 8-second windows. Production runs use streaming gates and their native readout cadence; rows are not a controlled latency comparison. Removing region agreement and widening the mask are diagnostic experiments, not released fixes.

Each trace is centered and scaled independently within the selected window. Time is unchanged: no alignment fitting, time warping or beat-spacing regularization. Gaps in committed waveforms remain gaps.
